notes.title: Come Watch Us Play the B-Side Demo June 16th!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone!

We'll be taking part in the upcoming Next Fest from June 16 - June 22 and are super excited! As part of it, we'll be streaming a playthrough of our demo at 12pm PST on June 16th.

Feel free to stop by and chat, ask questions, or just chill and watch us play - we'd love to have you :D

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396092/c5f9e6259c37dd6cecf1499e7ac3b9cc05b4683e.gif[/img]

Also, if you haven't already, you can give the B-Side demo a try for yourself! Get acquainted with Tae and their initial struggles of the Forming on their journey to find their B-Side!

See you during the festival!

notes.title: B-Side Demo Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Follow Tae on their journey in The Forming, unlock 30+ levels, & avoid succumbing to the Wither using your ability to flip the world around you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396092/6f7dc8dd0b1eff8e433a570b3caf1c39f37a5ecb.gif[/img]

Go give the demo a try and let us know what you think! 🦑

While the gameplay probably won’t change much from this demo, there’s still a lot we’d like to polish out as we get closer to a full launch.

We’re just excited to have something officially playable and want to hear any and all feedback - it’ll just make the game better! :D

notes.title: B-Side Demo Coming April 13th!
notes.notes:
Hey there everybody! 

If you've been itching to try out B-Side for yourself, you'll be able to get a little taste on April 13th!

The demo will be a condensed version of Act 1 of the game, where you'll get an intro to the story and a feel for some of the basic puzzles. You'll also start to get acquainted with the main character Tae, and the first of three other characters, Lae!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38396092/fd6df262391f4a1e32b681dfa02d0c1089e75846.gif[/img]

We're super excited for you to try it out! Are you excited??

Give us a follow to stay up to date on when it's available and for future development updates! 🦑
